summary: The two spikes are the "ASK YOUR DOCTOR" lower-third wiping in and out, which is intended graphics, so I found no pops or render faults. The one minor point is that the subject is tiny and cropped at the top-right edge, so I can't confirm the thumbs-up.

faults.fix: Reframe so the seated man is larger and more central, or put the title bar lower or smaller so it doesn't outweigh him.
